## Natural history notes

A medium-sized band-winged grasshopper characterized by its mottled gray to brown body, long antennae, and patterned hindwings that flash during short flights. In Florida, it is found in dry sandy habitats such as scrub, sandhills, pine flatwoods, open pinewoods, dunes, roadsides, and other sparsely vegetated areas with exposed ground. It feeds mainly on grasses and low herbaceous plants, usually resting camouflaged on sand or bare soil and escaping disturbance with quick jumps or short, low flights.
